purpose: Can the existing E0051 development models pick moments where their chosen one-direction series UP^n or DOWN^n hits more often than theory (2^-n) and than causal empirical frequencies of official outcomes? Main test n=5; n=2,3,4 auxiliary; n=1 directional quality control. Research diagnostic on development only; no holdout, no live model/config, no PnL.

source_experiment.stage_models_note: Saved E0051 C0/F1/F2 model.txt files (SHA-256 verified against task.json) are re-applied, without refitting, to every decision slot of their own stage so the selector stream does not depend on label completeness; saved predictions.parquet (complete-label windows only) are used as an equivalence check. H models and holdout data are never opened.

evaluation_window_rule: official complete n-sequence (all n exact 5m keys present with outcome), all n starts < fold end (E0051 rule), label_available_at known and < development cutoff; labels never gate the selector stream

signal_rule.p_up: p[2^n-1] (all bits 1 = all UP, E0051 coding sum_k y_k 2^k)
signal_rule.side: argmax(p_up, p_down); exact tie -> skip and count
signal_rule.ranking_score: max(p_up, p_down) from raw (uncalibrated) model vectors
signal_rule.hit: all n official outcomes equal the chosen side

selector.full_set: every evaluable window with a non-tied side
selector.threshold: for decision T: quantile 1-coverage of ranking scores of the same variant and n at stream decisions t with T-14d <= t < T (strictly earlier on the decision axis T-60s; all decision slots, labelled or not; stream starts at C0 2026-05-01 and crosses fold boundaries; scores of earlier slots come from the model of the stage that contained them)
selector.min_window_note: at least 7 of 14 days of 5m decisions; F1 starts after exactly 14 days of C0, so the minimum is never binding in F1/F2
selector.selection: score strictly greater than threshold; score equal to threshold is not selected and is counted; missing threshold -> not selected

benchmarks.theory: 2^-n for the chosen side (independent fair candles)
benchmarks.global: E0051 Laplace(1) class frequencies of official windows with label_available_at <= fold start - 60s; probability of the chosen side's class
benchmarks.conditional: E0051 known_streak_state table (official outcomes available by T-60s, lookback 3 slots, cap 4) shrunk to global with 20 pseudo-observations, fitted at fold start - 60s; unseen state -> global prior
benchmarks.control_selector: same model side per window, ranking score = conditional benchmark probability of that side, same rolling 14-day 1-coverage quantile rule over its own stream (C0 decisions use the benchmark fitted at C0 start - 60s)

calibration: raw vectors only; predicted-vs-observed shown diagnostically; no calibrated variant fitted

uncertainty.method: common-block circular moving-block bootstrap over UTC days within each fold and pooled F1+F2

future_test_conditions: An independent evaluation needs agreed unseen boundaries, frozen models per fold, the selector exactly as above (14-day rolling strictly-earlier stream of all decision slots, warm-up >= 2016 scores, strict >), benchmarks refitted at each fold start - 60s from labels available by then, and documented feature receipt and label observation times. Not authorized by this task.
